subject.title: [Feature]: Support non-durable native dreaming mode / explicit phase controls

question: Should production Dreaming gain a stable non-durable policy, and should that policy be a single durable-promotion gate or supported per-phase controls?
rationale: Current schema contains internal phase structure, but public docs intentionally avoid treating phases as user modes; choosing the permanent compatibility surface and guarantee requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Add Non-Durable Policy
options.body: Expose one stable `durablePromotion: false`-style policy while keeping phase sequencing internal and proving protected startup memory remains unchanged.

options.title: Support Phase Controls
options.body: Promote phase `enabled` fields to documented public configuration and define upgrade compatibility for independently disabling deep.

options.title: Keep Preview Only
options.body: Retain `rem-harness` as the only non-writing lane and explicitly document that scheduled production Dreaming always includes durable promotion.

recommendation.title: Add Non-Durable Policy
recommendation.body: Expose one stable `durablePromotion: false`-style policy while keeping phase sequencing internal and proving protected startup memory remains unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The major Dreaming configuration and runtime alignment history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for deciding the stable public contract.
